items.html: Indeed, Atik and Arich, called Keter de Atzilut, take the two Behinot of the name MA between them, which are Taamim – Keter, and Nekudot – Hochma. This is because each Dechura side of Atik is made of Keter, being Taamim de MA, and each Dechura side of Arich is made of Hochma, being Nekudot de MA. Thus, only Keter de Atzilut, which is Behinat Atik and Arich, takes the Keter and Hochma of MA to the Dechura side of them, and only the both of them are called Keter de Atzilut.
